mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Defender 130 D350 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete rebuilt Land Rover Defender 130 D350 engine typically costs between £6,500 and £10,000 for supply only [ESTIMATED]. Used units start from around £2,500. Reconditioned units range from £4,500 to £7,500. Prices vary based on the specific AJ20D6 / DT306 engine code and supplier.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of oil filter housing or cooling failure in a Defender 130 D350?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include sudden drops in oil pressure, visible oil leaks under the vehicle, or dashboard warning lights indicating low oil levels. Unusual engine noises or knocking due to oil starvation. Sweet smells or steam from the engine bay indicating coolant mixing. Reduced performance or limp mode activation.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Defender 130 D350?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. The Land Rover Defender 130 D350 is a high-value premium SUV with current market values ranging from £75,000 to over £95,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A rebuilt engine cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's total value. It preserves the car's towing capability, refinement, and resale value. Upgraded rebuilt units address known factory component weaknesses.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Defender 130 D350 engine supply and fit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional Land Rover Defender 130 D350 engine replacement typically takes 3 to 5 working days. Removal and preparation of the old unit takes 1-2 days. Fitting, calibration, and 48V MHEV system testing of the new rebuilt engine takes 2-3 days. Nationwide collection and delivery are arranged by the specialist.

mainEntity.name: Do rebuilt D350 engines retain the 48V mild-hybrid (MHEV) functionality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, reputable specialists rebuilding a Land Rover Defender 130 D350 engine ensure full compatibility with the 48V mild-hybrid architecture. The integrated starter-generator (ISG) and associated electrical components are tested and calibrated. All MHEV software maps are retained or updated to factory specifications. This ensures seamless stop-start operation and torque-fill performance.

problems.group: Oil Filter Housing & Cooling System Vulnerability
problems.h4: Oil Filter Housing & Cooling System Vulnerability - Why the Land Rover Defender 130 D350 AJ20D6 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: The oil filter housing, constructed from a specific plastic composite, can become brittle and crack under thermal stress, leading to sudden oil loss and potential engine seizure if not addressed.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacement with updated, more durable housing material
Supply & fit of a rebuilt 3.0L I6 with upgraded cooling components and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if oil starvation has caused bearing damage or block scoring

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Defender 130 D350 holds a current UK market value of £75,000-£95,000+ depending on specification and mileage [THIRD-PARTY]. At this valuation, a rebuilt engine replacement cost represents a small fraction of the vehicle's total value, making professional replacement highly viable to preserve its premium status.
problems.recommendation: Proactive inspection and replacement of the oil filter housing is a highly recommended, low-cost preventative measure. If oil starvation has already occurred, a full rebuilt engine replacement is the safest and most reliable solution to protect your investment.
